The ZA Domain Name Authority (ZADNA) invites suitably qualified and experienced Bidders from the broader ICT and domain name sectors to submit binding proposals for the provision of Registry Services for the Commercial SLDs within the .za namespace.

The Successful Bidder will be required to manage and administer the Commercial SLDs and their Registry Databases; provide authoritative DNS, registration data directory and related Registry Services; process domain name transactions through a secure Shared Registry System; collect and account for applicable fees; support and accredit registrars; and perform all associated continuity, security, compliance and reporting obligations.

A mandatory Briefing session will be held on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 11h00AM for all service providers. The session will be held online and be recorded via Microsoft Teams which will be shared upon request. Confirmation to be sent to procurements@zadna.org.za on Thursday, 19 November 2026

The submissions should be emailed to procurements@zadna.org.za no later than Monday, 14 December 2026, 12h00 SAST.

Enquiries should be directed to Ms Sibongile Ndlovu (Finance Manager) at procurements@zadna.org.za ;telephone number 010 020 3910

Tenders are hereby invited from capable and experienced service providers for the above tender. 

1.	Only tenderers who have provided the following mandatory information and documents to be used to evaluate the bidder's responsiveness will be considered for further evaluation on functionality;

1.	Only tenderers who have provided the following mandatory information and documents to be used to evaluate the 	tenderers responsiveness will be considered for further evaluation on functionality and preference specific goals.
1.1	Only tenderers who are registered on the Central Supplier Database (CSD) will be considered and the copy of	the full CSD report not older than three months should be submitted.
1.2	No tender shall be considered for the person who are in the service of the state,
1.3	Valid SARS PIN certificate must be attached,
1.4	Attached original Certified copy of company registration documents issued by Companies and Intellectual	Property	commission (CIPC) and tenderer must attach shareholder’s certificates where applicable.
1.5	Attached original Certified copies of Identity Documents (ID) of all company directors,
1.6	Attach verifiable Municipal Account/s not older than three months for both the tenderer and entity owner/s or 			director/s. In areas where the municipalities are not issuing municipal accounts, attach valid lease agreements or 		confirmation of residence or address for both the tenderer and entity owner/s or director/s issued by a relevant		authority not older than three months.
1.7	Tenderers submitting tenders as a joint venture or consortium must attach a signed agreement by all parties to 		the joint 	venture or consortium.
1.8	Fully completed tender document as issued and signed must be submitted on the PDF document that has been 		issued.   All the certified documents as stated must not be older than three months.
1.9	Tenderers are advised not to commit any fraudulent activities, including forgery of documents. All abuses of the 		Supply Chain Management (SCM) systems including but not limited to forgery of returnable documents, may be 		reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS) and restricted from doing business with any public institution 		or organ of the state for a period not exceeding 10 years in line with the Prevention of Fraud and Corrupt Activities 		Act 12 of 2004.
2.	This tender will be evaluated on the two-stage bidding process as follows: 

2.1	The first stage will be evaluated on mandatory requirements and functionality criteria as stated in the tender document.
2.2	The second stage will be on financial offers and only service providers that reach the minimum threshold on the functionality points will be invited to submit financial offers on the catalytic projects to be identified by the municipality.

Tender Documents can be viewed and downloaded at no cost on Document sharing and collaboration Platform or Portal (NEPTUNE): http://edmservices.ehlanzeni.gov.za and National Treasure Portal from Friday, 18 December 2026.
